knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Release must be documented first. A quick wipe or a room restriction does not replace it.
An improvised method can damage the tool and leave contamination behind.

practicalCriteria: The learner builds a register for fictional assets showing clean and quarantined status. Pass: each asset has a status and a release field.
In a fictional scenario, the learner identifies the items that must not be booked until release. Pass: every item used on the suspect task is listed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: An item has no documented history.
A cleaning method is not approved for the item.
